$comment: Known violations of scripts/check-versioning-cell.mjs (srs#649), same discipline as scripts/spec-coherence-allowlist.json and scripts/publication-reachability-exclusions.json. Entry shape: {path, id, fromCommit, toCommit, disposition, issue, note}. `path`/`id` name the Field, `fromCommit`/`toCommit` (7+ hex chars, prefix-matched) pin the exact historical transition so a distinct future violation on the same Field is never silently absorbed. `disposition` is "permanent" (a ruled, settled outcome — closure of `issue` is expected) or "pending" (real follow-up remains — `issue` should still be open). The check fails on any violation NOT listed here and on any entry that no longer matches a violation — shrinking this file IS the fix; growing it needs a live issue.

entries.note: srs#534 added "ref" to value_range's allowedValues with no version bump. Root cause: gen-metamodel-package.mjs's fieldFile() hardcodes version:1 for every generated Field — there is no per-field version override to bump. Tracked, not fixed here (out of scope for the smallest-honest-check this file's sibling check is).
